title: Logback writes an encoder header after every rotation
summary: The active file after one rotation changed from BF to HBF. Two rotations on the fix produced HAF, HF and HBF from oldest to newest. Without rotation both pins wrote HABF.

change.description: Before, expect archive 1 = `HAF` and current = `BF`, consistent with #857. After, expect archive 1 = `HAF` and current = `HBF`.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.
